domain: Finite U4 workshop material laws. Complete procedures are runtime outputs. Initial needs, affordances and primitive practice opportunities are supplied.

induction: Initial concept uses observed starting condition. Counterexamples trigger a separator from observed feature differences and preserve successful branch as a versioned subprocedure. This is a declared engineering induction rule.
held_out_scope: Transfer fixtures excluded from acquisition and induction until first execution; declared development panel, not U14 release holdouts.
regression: Reproduce U8 610 distinct tests, all U2-U8 native witnesses, and preserve all baseline bytes.
claim_boundary: No arbitrary semantics, unbounded practical search, natural-language generation, spontaneous institution, or arbitrary-composition closure.
